title: Asiad: Sibol cops bronze in Pokémon Unite
summary: The Philippines, represented by Sibol, settled for a bronze medal after a 0-2 loss to Indonesia in the semifinals of the Pokémon Unite esports event on Sunday at the Aichi Sky Expo Hall on Sunday.
